title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Service-Level Schedule: Scheduling Notice, In-House Attempts, Dealer Sublets and Open Orders
content:
The operations service-level schedule for ADAS Sensor Calibrations sets, by tier, the business days of notice needed to schedule a calibration, how many in-house attempts are made before an order is sublet, the dealer sublet terms, whether the customer may wait at the center, how many calibration orders one source may have open at once, and whether the customer may decline the calibration.

## Schedule

| Tier | Scheduling notice (business days) | Most in-house attempts before sublet | Sublet to a franchised dealer allowed once in-house attempts are exhausted | Dealer turnaround for a sublet (business days) | Transport to and from the dealer at no charge | Customer may wait at the center during the calibration | Calibration orders one source may have open at once | Customer may decline the calibration and take the vehicle uncalibrated |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dynamic Camera Calibration | 1 | 3 | yes | 3 | yes | yes | 1 | yes |
| Static Camera Calibration | 2 | 2 | yes | 3 | yes | yes | 1 | yes |
| Dual-Mode Camera Calibration | 2 | 3 | yes | 3 | yes | yes | 1 | yes |
| Blind Spot Radar Calibration | 2 | 2 | yes | 3 | yes | yes | 1 | yes |
| Front Radar Calibration | 2 | 2 | yes | 4 | yes | yes | 1 | no |
| Multi-System Calibration | 3 | 3 | yes | 5 | yes | no | 1 | no |

A "source" is the glass job, insurance claim repair, customer-pay repair or warranty rework the calibration order was opened for.

## Questions answered by the schedule

**How many in-house attempts does a Static Camera Calibration order get before it is sublet?** Two; the same figure applies to Blind Spot Radar Calibration and Front Radar Calibration. Dynamic Camera Calibration, Dual-Mode Camera Calibration and Multi-System Calibration orders get three.

**How long is the dealer given on a sublet?** Three business days on the three camera tiers and Blind Spot Radar Calibration, four on Front Radar Calibration and five on Multi-System Calibration.

**On which tiers may the customer not wait at the center?** Multi-System Calibration only.

**On which tiers may the customer not decline the calibration?** Front Radar Calibration and Multi-System Calibration.
